CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Wired the self-hosting test suite (lexer/parser/region/emit) into real CI on all 3 platforms, closing a real, previously-flagged verification gap. Immediately found and fixed 2 real Windows-only bugs no local check could catch: SDL_main.h's own main() signature hijacking, then the resulting undefined WinMain link error once SDL2main wasn't actually linked. v0.89.0 (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e) (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
